summary: Implemented KAFKA-20282: Classic consumer log recommendation for next gen Consumer rebalance protocol. Added an INFO level log message to ClassicKafkaConsumer that recommends the new Consumer rebalance protocol (KIP-848) when a KafkaConsumer is instantiated with CLASSIC protocol and a group ID configured. The log message "The consumer rebalance protocol (KIP-848) is production ready!" is displayed to users, informing them about the production-ready next-generation consumer protocol. All 4 new tests pass: testClassicProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, testConsumerProtocolDoesNotLogRecommendation, testDefaultProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, and testNoGroupIdDoesNotLogGroupProtocolMessage. The entire KafkaConsumerTest suite passes with BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
